etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: From Middle English apesen, from Old French apeser (“to pacify, bring to peace”).
senses: To make quiet; to calm; to reduce (something) to a state of peace; to dispel (anger, hatred, etc.).
To make conciliatory offerings or concessions to (someone) in an attempt to dispel their anger, aggression, etc.; to adapt to the demands of; to come to terms with.
